title: An Idea Becomes a Connected System

scenes.title: Idea placed on the sheet
scenes.purpose: Establish the paper desk, the heading and the idea as a placed paper object
visuals: pale blue-grey engineering paper on a slate desk with a stationary vignette and grain
handwritten heading revealed one word per drawing
terracotta pencil underline grows in held steps
cream paper idea card with hatched terracotta bulb placed via five replacement drawings (lift, descend, press, settle, rest), then taped

beats.development: Heading words begin appearing; caption strip starts typing
captions: an idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: Idea card is set down in held stop-motion poses with overshoot and settle; underline completes; tape and highlight glint added

scenes.title: Connections and boxes
scenes.purpose: Show the idea branching into three parts that link into one system
visuals: three graphite connectors draw from the card
each box drawn one side per drawing; label and detail appear only once its box is complete
translucent sage highlighter swash marks the centre of the system

beats.development: Connectors draw; boxes sketch, build, share complete and receive labels
Links between boxes draw and the highlighter swash marks the system; caption finishes typing
captions: One spark, drawn out, links into a working whole.

scenes.title: Reading hold
scenes.purpose: Let the completed diagram and caption read
visuals: all drawings locked to their rest variant; nothing moves

findings: Drawings are exposed at 10 per second (3 delivery frames each) to read as stop-motion rather than tweened
Heading is complete by 0.6 s; box labels by 1.9 s; detail lines and caption by 2.1 s
justifiedHolds: 2.4-3.0 s final hold so the diagram, labels and caption can be read

notes: Silent preview: no soundtrack or effects
